evidence: Single package structure with clear domain-specific modules (website_actions) and entry points (main.py, downloader.py)
Abstract base class (WebsiteActions) used for polymorphic behavior across website-specific implementations (BookwalkerJP, CmoaJP, etc.)
All components in one repository, no inter-process or network boundaries between components
High cohesion within modules (each website action file handles one website's logic), moderate coupling via imports and shared Downloader
Architecture metrics show low package count (1), shallow directory depth (2), and moderate average fan-out (4.3)
Use of inheritance and common interface suggests intentional modularity but no separation of concerns into layers or distinct architectural layers (e.g., no persistence/api/service separation)
risks: Risk of tight coupling if website action modules evolve independently without strong interface discipline
Lack of process isolation may cause stability issues if one website scraper crashes the entire application
No clear separation between UI/business logic/persistence makes testing and maintenance harder as project scales
